summary: One test failed due to the contact form element not being found and thus not visible on the page.
rootCause: The test failed because the locator 'form#contactForm' did not find any matching element on the page within the timeout period, causing the visibility check to fail.

failedTests.testName: TC-001: Verify accessibility of the contact form
failedTests.errorMessage: expect(locator('form#contactForm')).toBeVisible() failed: element(s) not found within 5000ms timeout.
failedTests.likelyCause: The selector 'form#contactForm' does not match any element on the page, possibly due to changes in the application DOM or incorrect selector in the test.
failedTests.recommendation: Verify that the selector 'form#contactForm' correctly identifies the contact form element in the application. Update the selector if the DOM structure has changed or fix the application if the form is missing.

recommendations: Check the application page at the URL `${baseURL}/contact` to confirm the presence and correct ID of the contact form element.
Review and update the selector in the test if the form's ID or structure has changed.
If the form is missing due to an application defect, coordinate with the development team to fix the issue.
Consider adding debugging logs or screenshots (already attached) to assist in diagnosing the issue further.
releaseImpact: High - The failure indicates a critical UI element (contact form) is not accessible, which may block user interactions and affect release quality.
